title: Microsoft Maps Year-Long ShinyHunters-Linked Salesforce Data Theft Across Three Paths
summary: Attackers whose methods line up with the data-extortion group ShinyHunters have spent the past year walking into corporate Salesforce environments without exploiting a single flaw in the platform.
card_summary: Attackers whose methods line up with the data-extortion group ShinyHunters have spent the past year walking into corporate Salesforce environments without exploiting a single flaw in the platform.

sections.impact:
The way in has been the trust the organization had already extended, usually through the OAuth connections that tie Salesforce to the apps and third-party vendors around it.

Assessed severity: MEDIUM.
